info.title: SupportDesk API
info.description: REST API of the SupportDesk customer support app. All paths are under /api/v1. Errors always use { error: { code, message, details } }. List endpoints accept page, limit (max 100), sort and dir and return { items, page, limit, total, totalPages }. Tenant isolation: records outside the caller's project scope are reported as 404, never 403.
